description: This is the main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. It defines the app entry point, theme, main game page with state management, game logic, and UI components including game board, status indicators, and reset functionality.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Tic Tac Toe application, sets up theme and initializes main page.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main game screen, handling game state, user interactions, and UI layout.

classes.name: _TicTacToePageState
classes.description: State class for TicTacToePage, managing game logic, user input, and rendering.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Stateless widget representing an individual cell in the game board, handling display and tap animations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: handleTap
methods.description: Processes a player's move when a cell is tapped, updating game state and checking for win or draw.

methods.name: _checkWinner
methods.description: Checks current board state for a winner based on winning line conditions.

methods.name: _isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game has resulted in a draw (full board with no winner).
